newsitem.title: UK: Sakura Bank plans $600 mln perpetual FRN -bankers.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Bank plans $600 mln perpetual FRN -bankers.

text.p: Top Japanese bank Sakura Bank Ltd is expected to issue a $600 million perpetual FRN next week, bankers said on Friday.
Merrill Lynch and Sakura Bank were likely to be joint lead managers of the deal, they said. Officials at the banks declined to comment.
The deal was likely to have a step-up coupon and a call after five years. The initial coupon was expected to be Libor plus 90 basis points, bankers said.

Sakura launched a $1.0 billion perpetual issue in February, in a move to expand its investor base away from Japan. That deal was split into a $400 million fixed-rate tranche and a $600 million FRN, both with calls after five years.
Merrill Lynch underwrote the subordinated deal, which was rated Baa2 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB by Standard & Poor's. -- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
